sloka: तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं नि:श्वसन्तं पुन:पुन: ।भ्रातरं भरतं राम: परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् ॥ २.१०४.१५॥
transliteration: taṁ mattamiva mātaṅgaṁ ni:śvasantaṁ puna:puna: ।bhrātaraṁ bharataṁ rāma: pariṣvajyedamabravīt ॥ 2.104.15॥

translations.english: Rama embraced his brother Bharata who repeatedly heaved sighs and resembled an elephant in rut, and said:
